dimensions.assessment: Affects federal child care program administrators, state agencies, and families utilizing child care and Head Start programs nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: $25,500,000,000... to the Administration for Children and Families within the Department of Health and Human Services

dimensions.assessment: Shifts massive amounts of funding ($70 billion) between federal agencies, substantially changing resources for child care programs and border enforcement.
dimensions.evidence: $70,000,000,000 are hereby rescinded... provides a total of $70 billion to ACF for federal child care programs

dimensions.assessment: Rescinds $70 billion from ICE and CBP and appropriates $70 billion to the Administration for Children and Families available through FY2029.
dimensions.evidence: rescinds $70 billion in funding that was provided to ICE and CBP... provides a total of $70 billion to ACF for federal child care programs

dimensions.assessment: Directs supplemental appropriations and rescinds existing appropriations without creating entirely new statutory programs.
dimensions.evidence: To provide supplemental appropriations for certain programs of the Administration for Children and Families, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Funds remain available through fiscal year 2029, representing multi-year funding impacts.
dimensions.evidence: to remain available through fiscal year 2029

importance_detail.rationale: The bill reallocates $70 billion in federal funding from immigration enforcement agencies to federal child care and early learning programs through fiscal year 2029.
